name: Shambling Mound

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Lightning damage heals the mound instead of harming it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one with Engulf.

actions.name: Charged Tendril
actions.desc: If the target is Medium or smaller, it is pulled 5 feet toward the mound.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: A Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet makes a DC 15 Strength save or is engulfed: Blinded, Restrained, and takes 9 (2d8) Lightning damage at the start of each of the mound's turns.

desc: A walking heap of rotting vegetation, drawn to storms and to anything warm.
